title: The Window of Repairer Entries Read on a ShieldCare Repair Claim
content:
The entries read from the job on a covered item under a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan are
those booked inside a window, and the length of that window turns on two things: whether a diagnosis
stands recorded on that job in the records of Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair inside the
last 12 months, and whether the plan is one whose claims are worked ahead of the ordinary queue.

| What the records show | The window read |
| --- | --- |
| a diagnosis stands recorded on the job for the covered item inside the last 12 months, and the plan is one whose claims are worked ahead of the ordinary queue | the entries booked in the last 3 months are read |
| such a diagnosis stands recorded, and the plan is not one whose claims are worked ahead of the ordinary queue | the entries booked in the last 6 months are read |
| every other plan | the entries booked in the last 12 months are read |

### Both sides of the condition

A diagnosis recorded on the job 11 months ago is inside the last 12 months and opens the first two
rows; one recorded 13 months ago is not, and the window read is then the last 12 months whether or
not the plan's claims are worked ahead of the queue. Where a diagnosis does stand inside the year,
the queue position alone separates a window of 3 months from one of 6.

### The combinations set out

| Diagnosis on the job inside the last 12 months | Claims worked ahead of the queue | Window read |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no | no | 12 months |
| no | yes | 12 months |
| yes | no | 6 months |
| yes | yes | 3 months |
